comments.name: Rituraj
comments.text: It is essentially the digital equivalent of a fuel gauge for your creativity; knowing exactly how much "intelligence" you have left before the next reset prevents the dreaded workflow cliff. By making consumption visible, it forces a more intentional approach to how we prompt, ensuring that we prioritize our most critical architectural decisions before the quota runs dry. This is exactly the kind of utility that bridges the gap between raw AI power and professional, sustainable software development.
